predictions.articleTitle: Reading vs Bromley Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Robinson's Backline Halt Marriott? — xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Reading hold a clear statistical and home-venue edge to defeat 24th-placed Bromley in an open match featuring Over 2.5 goals and Both Teams To Score.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Thesis: Reading Home Win backed by 1.85 xG/match and 71.4% home win rate against Bromley's 2.12 xGA/match (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Scoring Thesis: Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS Yes driven by 3.23 total lambda and Bromley's 85.7% away scoring rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Chronological Thesis: Draw-Win or Win-Win progression as Reading's second-half home firepower exploits Bromley's depleted backline (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
